purpose: Public seller shop with server total/unique + offset pagination and CT-like filters.

params.query: sellerUsername required; game, limit (max 100), offset, q, condition, language, sort.

purpose: List and append typed events in a canonical private conversation, including atomic direct PKN payments.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; conversation membership is enforced server-side.

params.query: action=list|get and peer for one conversation.
params.body: peer plus text, or a positive whole amountPkn and clientToken for payment.

purpose: Create, pay, decline, or cancel PKN requests represented as typed conversation events.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; request parties and transitions are enforced server-side.

params.body: recipientUsername, amountPkn, note, and clientToken for create; requestId for transitions.

purpose: Reconcile the seller's complete CardTrader inventory into Pokoin (import/link/update/remove linked stock only).
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; seller must have CardTrader connected.

params.query: GET returns last sync status; POST runs reconcile.

purpose: Signed-in seller's CardTrader 1-Day Ready inventory as dashboard assets (never Pokoin listings).
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; uid from verified token only.

purpose: Stored daily collection value: wallet on the days it moved, plus the homepage minimum of 1-Day Ready cards summed once per UTC day.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; uid from verified token only.

purpose: Signed-in recently seen public card ids, scoped by game at storage/query. Writer is the nezopt marketplace primary. Tile JSON is not stored.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; uid from verified token only.

params.query: game required (pokemon|one_piece|riftbound) unless satellite Host / x-pokoin-game supplies it.
params.body: POST { game, cardId } records one view; PUT { game, cardIds } replaces that game list. Cards must exist in the game catalog.

purpose: Poko market intelligence: read-only card resolution, sold-market quotes, liquidity, artist collection quotes, snapshot. One shared tool surface for every Poko channel.
auth: Required service bearer token: POKO_MARKET_SERVICE_TOKEN, or POKONTACT_SERVICE_TOKEN (same secret, already in the Pi container env). Server-to-server only; browsers never receive it.

params.body: { tool: resolve_card|card_quote|card_liquidity|collection_quote|market_snapshot, params } with tool-specific fields (query, cardId, condition, language, artist, limit).

purpose: Website Poko assistant chat. Accepts message + attached cards; proxies Hermes when configured, otherwise consults local poko-market tools.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token. Browser never receives the Hermes/poko-market service token.

params.body: { message, cards?: [{ cardId, name, setName, condition, language }], sessionId? }

purpose: Seller ship-from country (ISO-2) and Stripe Connect readiness.
Encrypted buyer shipping addresses; countryCode stays queryable outside ciphertext.
auth: Required Firebase bearer token; owner only.

params.query: id for PUT/DELETE; reveal=1 to decrypt for owner

purpose: Per-seller shipment quotes from seeded rate tables. Fail closed when route missing.
Stripe Connect Express onboarding and READY status sync.
Freeze EUR order + encrypted address snapshot, open Stripe Checkout Session.
Link a signed-in Pokoin account to a Telegram user for the Poko assistant: create link code (Firebase user), redeem/status/unlink (service token via Hermes).
auth: create_code: Firebase bearer token. redeem/status/unlink: service bearer token (POKO_MARKET_SERVICE_TOKEN or POKONTACT_SERVICE_TOKEN).

params.body: { action: create_code|redeem|status|unlink, ... } — create_code takes no params; redeem takes code + telegram { userId, username, displayName }; status/unlink take telegramUserId.
